title: semanticfa: reproduction archive for "semanticfa: An R Package for Response-Free Semantic Factor Analysis of Psychometric Scales"
description: Release of the semanticfa R package repository whose reproduce folder regenerates every number, table, and figure of the worked example in the paper "semanticfa: An R Package for Response-Free Semantic Factor Analysis of Psychometric Scales" (Yanitski and Westbury, submitted to Behavior Research Methods). The folder holds the master script (reproduce.R), its full console transcript (reproduce.Rout), the archived embeddings, the outputs, and the figures; see reproduce/README.md. The human response file is not redistributed; the README says where to download it.
